breakpoint_contract.target: executable line ID in the pinned source digest
breakpoint_contract.effect: pause at the next matching committed safe point
breakpoint_contract.persistence: survive reconnect and process restart for the same ExecutionId and source digest; clear on reload to a new ExecutionId
breakpoint_contract.monitor_rule: M mode may observe but cannot mutate breakpoints

run_to_line_contract.target: statically reachable executable line in the same lexical frame and procedure
run_to_line_contract.effect: install one one-shot breakpoint, run, pause on the target, and remove the one-shot breakpoint

console_rule: The console accepts only a typed operation object from console_operations; WRITE_TYPED_LITERAL uses the identical edit matrix and guards.

user_action_contract.handler: statically resolved allowlisted BOUNDED_IR_ACTION_BLOCK in the pinned bundle
user_action_contract.invoke_rule: An authenticated C-mode holder creates one durable invocation; it executes synchronously at an allowed safe point under the accepted revisions or settles rejected, cancelled, or superseded.
user_action_contract.restart_rule: Reconcile the same InvocationId and target event; never invoke the handler twice.
